stem: April wants to add a supporting sentence to the third paragraph (sentences 11–18). Which sentence should be added after sentence 13?

options.label: A
options.text: Stevenson saw a way to improve skateboards.

options.label: B
options.text: Stevenson, however, was not the only inventor who significantly improved the design of skateboards.

options.label: C
options.text: Stevenson used his knowledge of shaping surfboards and applied it to shaping skateboards.
